name: OAC 252:606 Oklahoma Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (OPDES) Standards
access_detail: Chapter outline read on LII (justia returned 403): Subchapters 1, 3, 5, 6 (Point Source Discharges), 11 (Tests and Reports). No section titled on overflows or public notice in the outline; Subchapters 6 and 11 not read. OPDES permits carry the federal 24-hour / 5-day noncompliance condition (inferred from 40 CFR 122.41(l)(6) adoption).
status_reason: Municipal OPDES Part III (March 2017) B.6: oral notice to DEQ within 24 hours of awareness of any collection-system bypass or SSO, written in five days; Chapter 606 incorporates 40 CFR 122.41 (expansion research 2026-11-09).
